purpose: Normalize DXF group-440 alpha values and DWG ENC alpha_raw values at format boundaries without changing DRW_Entity layout or its established DWG-form transparency value.

sources.title: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF common group codes
sources.supports: Group 440 is an AcDbEntity transparency field and is a 32-bit integer group-code value.

sources.title: Autodesk AcCmTransparency methods
sources.supports: Transparency methods are ByLayer, ByBlock, and ByAlpha; alpha 0 is fully transparent and 255 is fully opaque.

sources.title: Autodesk AcCmTransparency method values
sources.supports: ObjectARX method values are kByLayer=0, kByBlock=1, and kByAlpha=2.

sources.title: LibreDWG common_entity_data.spec
sources.supports: DWG ENC alpha_raw stores alpha_type in the high byte and alpha in the low byte; DWG alpha_type 0/1/3 represents ByLayer/ByBlock/explicit alpha. Its DXF branch emits explicit alpha as the group-440 alpha field.

sources.title: ezdxf transparency documentation
sources.supports: DXF explicit alpha uses the 0x02 high-byte marker with an 8-bit alpha; alpha 0 is transparent and 255 opaque. The DXF ByBlock marker is 0x01000000 and ByLayer is absence.

representation.entityField: DRW_Entity::transparency remains the DWG ENC alpha_raw convention for source compatibility: 0x00000000 ByLayer, 0x01000000 ByBlock, and 0x030000TT with the low byte carrying explicit alpha.
representation.dxfGroup440: ByLayer is omitted; ByBlock is 0x01000000; explicit alpha is 0x020000TT.
representation.conversion: DXF parser normalizes 0x020000TT to entity 0x030000TT. DXF writers map either accepted explicit-alpha internal marker 0x02 or canonical 0x03 back to 0x020000TT. DWG writers map accepted marker 0x02 or canonical 0x03 to DWG alpha_type 3. ByBlock remains type 1; ByLayer remains zero/omitted. The legacy DRW::Transparent sentinel maps to explicit alpha zero. Unknown methods fail output; DXF parsing retains unknown values tolerantly.

implementation.abi: No public data-member or virtual-interface layout change.

validation.build: Passed: libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests, libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests, and libdxfrw_dwg_fixture_tests built with the project warning policy.

focused.result: Passed 1/1; covers DWG alpha type 3 ↔ DXF type 2 conversion, ByBlock, ByLayer, the legacy transparent sentinel, and unknown-method refusal.
Passed 1/1; existing XREF ASCII/Binary read/write/readback control confirms group 440 remains 33554560 (0x02000080) while the internal field is normalized to 0x03000080.

scopeLimit: This closes the selected representation conversion gap only. It does not establish native rendering, all producer encodings, transparency inheritance behavior in each consumer, or broader DWG/DXF support.
